evidence.quote: Park was not accused of any wrongdoing; auditors said he was interviewed as a standard part of confirming that till counts and transaction logs from his own window matched normal patterns, which they did.
Park told auditors he had not noticed anything unusual about Ortiz's till during the period covered by the investigation.

Kevin Park, another teller who worked alongside Ortiz, had provided a short written statement earlier in the case describing how till counts were normally logged at the end of each shift; he was not called to testify in person and was not named as a witness to any of the specific transfers at issue.
The class was led by branch staff, including teller Kevin Park, who walked attendees through a sample monthly budget worksheet.
Park fielded questions from attendees about how to read a monthly account statement and answered a handful of questions about setting up automatic savings transfers.
